raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Native FLUX turns on true CFG when `true_cfg_scale` is set with a negative prompt, but then combines the two branches with `guidance_scale`. A request with `true_cfg_scale=4` and the default `guidance_scale=3.5` therefore runs CFG at 3.5, unlike diffusers `FluxPipeline`, where `true_cfg_scale` is the CFG weight and `guidance_scale` only feeds the distilled guidance embedding.

## Modifications

`FluxPipelineConfig.get_classifier_free_guidance_scale` returns `true_cfg_scale` when it is set, the same override Qwen-Image already has. Without `true_cfg_scale`, the weight is still `guidance_scale`, so requests that do not set it are unchanged. FLUX.2 inherits the override.

Docs: the FLUX cookbook gains a "Negative prompts (true CFG)" section (which flag sets the CFG weight, an example, and the over-exposure seen at higher weights), and the `--true-cfg-scale` help now names FLUX.1.

## Accuracy Tests

Unit: `test_flux_true_cfg_scale.py` (new), `test_cfg_policy.py`, `test_cfg_gating.py`: 14 passed.

Against diffusers `FluxPipeline` on FLUX.1-dev (B200, seed 42, four prompts, guidance 3.5, BF16, both uncached), median over prompts:

| Setting | `main` vs diffusers | this PR vs diffusers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1024x1024, 50 steps, no true CFG | 25.04 dB / LPIPS 0.076 | identical to `main` |
| 512x512, 20 steps, no true CFG | 29.94 dB / LPIPS 0.020 | identical to `main` |
| 512x512, 20 steps, `true_cfg_scale=4` | 19.92 dB / LPIPS 0.165 | 26.67 dB / LPIPS 0.064 |
| 512x512, 50 steps, `true_cfg_scale=4` | 8.89 dB / LPIPS 0.589 | 17.53 dB / LPIPS 0.218 |

At 50 steps the strongly guided trajectory amplifies small numerical differences, so a gap to diffusers remains.

Note: true CFG 4 on top of FLUX.1-dev's distilled guidance (3.5) over-exposes images in diffusers as well (about 41-43% of pixels clipped to 0 or 255, up to 82% on a bright watercolor prompt), so that is not addressed here.

Two other differences from diffusers are left unchanged:
- the guidance embedding uses the server's `embedded_cfg_scale` (3.5 for FLUX.1), not the request's `guidance_scale`;
- a negative prompt alone enables CFG at weight `guidance_scale`, while diffusers defaults to `true_cfg_scale=1` (no CFG).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No change in the amount of work: only the CFG combination weight changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

### Re-verification (2026-10-15)

On the current head: `test_flux_true_cfg_scale.py`, `test_cfg_policy.py` and `test_cfg_gating.py` 14 passed, 8 subtests passed, 0 skipped; `pre-commit run --all-files` passes (Rust hooks skipped: no `cargo` here, no Rust files touched). The diffusers comparison numbers come from real FLUX.1-dev runs on a B200, and the metrics were recomputed with freshly installed `lpips` and `scikit-image` and a freshly downloaded AlexNet backbone, matching the recorded values exactly.

### Update (2026-10-15)

Re-ran against current `main` (`e87e32b311`) on a local merge of this head, which merges without conflicts: `test_flux_true_cfg_scale.py`, `test_cfg_policy.py` and `test_cfg_gating.py` 14 passed, 8 subtests passed, 0 skipped. Together with #44261 on current `main`, 36 FLUX.1-dev requests on a B200 were bit-identical to the earlier acceptance outputs. The branch itself is unchanged.

@@ -231,6 +231,24 @@ Use `--lora-path` at startup or the [LoRA management API](/docs/sglang-diffusion
 - [`XLabs-AI/flux-furry-lora`](https://huggingface.co/XLabs-AI/flux-furry-lora)
 - [`XLabs-AI/flux-RealismLora`](https://huggingface.co/XLabs-AI/flux-RealismLora)
 
+#### 4.2.4 Negative prompts (true CFG)
+
+FLUX.1-dev is guidance-distilled: its guidance embedding comes from the server's `--embedded-cfg-scale` (3.5 for FLUX.1), and the requests above run one DiT forward per step. A negative prompt turns on classifier-free guidance, which adds an unconditional forward per step:
+
+- `--true-cfg-scale` sets the CFG weight, as in diffusers `FluxPipeline`.
+- Without `--true-cfg-scale`, the negative prompt uses `--guidance-scale` as the CFG weight.
+
+```bash
+sglang generate \
+  --model-path black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev \
+  --prompt "A red bicycle leaning against a stone wall beside a quiet lake at sunset" \
+  --negative-prompt "blurry, distorted, low quality" \
+  --true-cfg-scale 2.0 \
+  --width 1024 --height 1024 --num-inference-steps 50 --seed 42
+```
+
+Keep the weight moderate. On top of the distilled guidance, CFG over-exposes FLUX.1-dev in diffusers as well as in SGLang: at 1024x1024 and 28 steps, about 45% of pixels clip to 0 or 255 at a weight of 4, and 8-15% at 1.5-2.
+

@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.flux import (
+    Flux2PipelineConfig,
+    FluxPipelineConfig,
+)
+
+
+class TestFluxTrueCFGScale(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_true_cfg_scale_is_the_cfg_weight(self):
+        for config in (FluxPipelineConfig(), Flux2PipelineConfig()):
+            with self.subTest(config=type(config).__name__):
+                batch = SimpleNamespace(true_cfg_scale=4.0)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    config.get_classifier_free_guidance_scale(batch, 3.5), 4.0
+                )
+
+    def test_guidance_scale_is_the_cfg_weight_without_true_cfg_scale(self):
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(true_cfg_scale=None)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            FluxPipelineConfig().get_classifier_free_guidance_scale(batch, 3.5), 3.5
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
